README: executed conditional demonstration, not a new physical-law closure. STATUS.md freeze remains v15.03. scientific_breakthrough: false. Pillar 3 OPEN.

13 Sep 2026 field note with Astra: 96 quantum simulations on a four-qubit carrier with two local chains A1→A2 and B1→B2. Six linear extensions of that poset. Reordering independent events preserved the state and joint probability at matching records, within ≈10⁻¹⁵. Ordered history, no imposed global clock. Outcomes supplied.

Computed: 6 interleavings × 16 four-bit outcomes = 96 runs. Same-record-set trace distance ≈ 1.02×10⁻¹⁵; joint-weight difference ≈ 1.39×10⁻¹⁶. Operators of incomparable events commute; τ_D, its trace, and the normalized state agree at matching completed-event sets. 27 new + 50 prior tests passed. Implementation check. Conditional model — not a derivation of time.
